label: log2 ratio to the inhibitor-free control

label: adjusted MADL sensitivity score
orientation: adjusted MADL sensitivity score = (r_L - med(r_L)) / MAD(r_L); 'negative = hypersensitive, positive = resistant' (hoepfner2014.py), kept as served
value_is: one deletion strain under one compound at one dose

label: fitness-defect log2 ratio, negated
